youtube.title: Night Prayer Today | Psalm 139:11-12 KJV
youtube.text:
Afraid of the dark tonight? Hear this.

"If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me. Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee." Psalm 139:11-12 (KJV)

Fall asleep to the Word: Psalms 125–150, KJV, read slowly: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2V6mjKBs0yo

Type amen, and send this to someone who can't sleep.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#NightPrayer #BibleVersesForSleep #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
